controls.name: Control Environment
controls.status_rationale: Repo ships governance ADRs and HARD RULE policies that describe a control environment posture.
controls.operator_boundary: Organization-level control environment effectiveness is operator-owned.

controls.name: Communication and Information
controls.status_rationale: ADRs, runbooks, and migration guides document internal communication posture; org training/comms is operator-owned.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns end-user communication, training program, and external information channel.

controls.name: Risk Assessment
controls.status_rationale: Plan-time cross-AI peer review process and risk matrices in ADRs document a risk assessment surface.
controls.operator_boundary: Enterprise risk assessment program operator-owned.

controls.name: Monitoring Activities
controls.status_rationale: CI gate, ao-release-gate, SLI/SLO catalog, and Alertmanager rule templates document a monitoring surface.
controls.operator_boundary: Ongoing management monitoring and review cadence is operator-owned.

controls.name: Control Activities
controls.status_rationale: ao-release-gate decision pipeline and invariant test suites document a repo-level control activity surface.
controls.operator_boundary: Operational control effectiveness is operator-owned audit subject.

controls.name: Logical and Physical Access
controls.status_rationale: Repo enforces secret-scan and no-secret-in-PR-body conventions; SSO, MFA, authn, and physical access are operator-owned.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns authn/SSO/MFA, key management, and physical access controls.

evidence_refs.ref: No Fake Work / No Cosmetic Operations (2026-04-25)

controls.name: System Operations
controls.status_rationale: OTEL tracing tunables (E-5-1), W3C trace context (E-5-3a), Alertmanager templates (E-5-5), and incident playbook (E-6-6) document a system operations surface.
controls.operator_boundary: Live deployment, scrape target provisioning, and alert delivery operator-owned.

controls.name: Change Management
controls.status_rationale: Cross-AI peer review HARD RULE plus CI gate plus ao-release-gate plus ADR-as-record document a strong change-management surface.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns production deployment change-control board and post-deploy verification.

controls.name: Risk Mitigation
controls.status_rationale: SBOM generator (E-6-1a), CodeQL workflow (E-6-5), Trivy fs scanner (E-6-2), and ao-release-gate document a vulnerability-mitigation surface.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns vendor risk program and supply-chain incident response.

controls.name: Availability (Trust Service Category)
controls.status_rationale: SLI/SLO catalog (E-5-4) and Alertmanager templates (E-5-5) document an availability monitoring surface; uptime SLI is explicitly out of scope in v1.
controls.operator_boundary: No uptime SLI in v1 (uptime_status.in_scope=false). No live operator deployment evidence. No BCP ownership.

controls.name: Confidentiality (Trust Service Category)
controls.status_rationale: Repo enforces secret-scan and no-secret-in-PR-body discipline; data classification and operator storage are out of scope.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns data classification, key management, and storage encryption.

evidence_refs.ref: No Fake Work / No Cosmetic Operations (2026-04-25)

controls.name: Processing Integrity (Trust Service Category)
controls.status_rationale: Schema validation (jsonschema Draft 2020-12 across all artifact types) and evidence trail (JSONL append-only) document a processing-integrity surface.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns business-process integrity outside repo runtime.

evidence_refs.description: JSONL evidence writer with SHA256 integrity manifest

controls.name: Privacy (Trust Service Category)
controls.status_rationale: ao-kernel runtime does not process repo-owned PII; operator privacy program owns DPIA, records of processing, and data subject rights.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator privacy program owns DPIA, ROPA, and data subject rights workflow.

controls.name: Information security policies
controls.status_rationale: Organization-level information security policy is operator-owned.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns information security policy authorship and approval.

controls.name: Organization of information security
controls.status_rationale: Organization-level role definition is operator-owned.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns role definition and segregation-of-duties matrix.

controls.name: Human resources security
controls.status_rationale: Human resources controls are operator-owned.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns hiring, training, and termination procedures.

controls.name: Asset management
controls.status_rationale: SBOM generator (E-6-1a) documents software asset inventory; physical and organizational asset management is operator-owned.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns physical asset inventory and organizational ownership records.

controls.name: Access control
controls.status_rationale: Logical access control is operator-owned.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns access control policy, provisioning, and review.

controls.name: Cryptography
controls.status_rationale: Cryptographic controls are operator-owned at transport layer.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns TLS, KMS, and key rotation.

controls.name: Physical and environmental security
controls.status_rationale: Physical security is operator-owned at hosting layer.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns datacenter and physical environment controls.

controls.name: Operations security
controls.status_rationale: Incident response playbook (E-6-6), monitoring surface (E-5-1/2/3/4/5), and SBOM/scanning (E-6-1/2/5) document operations security artifacts.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns live monitoring deployment and operational change board.

controls.name: Communications security
controls.status_rationale: Communications security is operator-owned at transport layer.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns network segmentation and transport encryption.

controls.name: System acquisition, development, and maintenance
controls.status_rationale: Cross-AI peer review HARD RULE plus CI gate plus ADR-as-record plus invariant tests document a system development surface.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns production maintenance cadence and post-deploy verification.

controls.name: Supplier relationships
controls.status_rationale: LLM provider vendor list is implicit in adapter registry; supplier contracts are operator-owned.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns vendor contract, SLA review, and supplier risk assessment.

controls.name: Information security incident management
controls.status_rationale: E-6-6 incident response playbook documents incident management surface; real incident org, notification, tabletop exercise, postmortem cadence are operator-owned.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns incident on-call rotation, customer notification, tabletop exercise schedule, and postmortem distribution cadence.

controls.name: Information security aspects of business continuity
controls.status_rationale: Business continuity is operator-owned.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns BCP, DR plan, and RTO/RPO target setting.

controls.name: Compliance
controls.status_rationale: This control-reference mapping documents a compliance documentation surface; certification, audit engagement, and regulatory determination are operator-owned.
controls.operator_boundary: Operator owns auditor engagement, certification scope, and regulatory determination.
